tavernEntrance.name: Tavern entrance
description: You stand in the entrance of a modest roadside tavern.
The room smells of smoke, spilled ale, and wet wool.

tavernEntranceFloor.name: Tavern floor
tavernEntranceFloor.selfText: You are standing near the tavern entrance.

bar.name: The bar
description: The bar counter is dark with age and spilled ale.
Shelves of mismatched bottles line the wall behind it.

barPublicSide.name: Public side of the bar
barPublicSide.publicText: The public side of the counter is worn smooth by years of elbows and spilled drink.
barPublicSide.enterLabel: Step to the public side of the bar
barPublicSide.selfText: You are standing on the public side of the counter.
barPublicSide.occupantTemplate: {name} stands on the public side of the counter.

barBehindCounter.name: Behind the bar
barBehindCounter.publicText: A narrow working space behind the counter holds taps, bottles, and a cabinet of empty mugs.
barBehindCounter.selfText: You are standing behind the bar.

commonRoom.name: The common room
description: Smoke gathers beneath the rafters above scarred tables and mismatched chairs.
A narrow wooden staircase climbs to a dim landing above the common room; a cramped nook has been curtained off beneath it.

commonRoomFloor.name: Common-room floor
commonRoomFloor.selfText: You are standing in the common room.

commonRoomTableOne.name: First table
commonRoomTableOne.publicText: The first table stands close to the fire.
commonRoomTableOne.selfText: You are sitting at the first table.

commonRoomTableTwo.name: Second table
commonRoomTableTwo.publicText: The second table sits nearer the shadowed wall.
commonRoomTableTwo.selfText: You are sitting at the second table.

underStairsNook.name: Nook beneath the stairs
underStairsNook.publicText: A curtain beneath the staircase hides a tiny sleeping nook with a narrow cot, a folded blanket, and almost no room for possessions.
underStairsNook.enterLabel: Step into the nook beneath the stairs
underStairsNook.selfText: You are in the cramped sleeping nook beneath the stairs.
underStairsNook.occupantTemplate: {name} is in the little sleeping nook beneath the stairs.

commonRoomTableThree.name: Third table
commonRoomTableThree.publicText: The third table stands a little apart from the others near the staircase.
commonRoomTableThree.selfText: You are sitting at the third table.

underStairsBed.name: Nell’s cot
underStairsBed.publicText: A narrow cot fills most of the curtained nook beneath the stairs.
underStairsBed.selfText: You are lying on the narrow cot beneath the stairs.
underStairsBed.occupantTemplate: {name} is lying on the narrow cot beneath the stairs.

timelapseActions.label: Clean the common room
timelapseActions.description: Collect unattended mugs around the common room, empty them, and return them to the mug cabinet.

street.name: The street
description: Cold rain falls upon the empty village street.
The tavern's windows glow warmly behind you.

streetCenter.name: Village street
streetCenter.selfText: You are standing in the village street.

villageTemple.name: Village temple
description: A tiny stone temple crouches at the edge of the village, smelling of cold incense and rain.
At the far end, beneath a soot-darkened icon, a crystal sphere rests on a crooked brass stand.

templeSanctum.name: Before the crystal sphere
templeSanctum.publicText: Pale light moves inside the sphere like a thought trying to remember its shape.
templeSanctum.selfText: You are standing before the crystal sphere.

upstairsCorridor.name: Upstairs corridor
description: The staircase opens onto a narrow timber landing above the common room.
Five closed doors line the corridor: the innkeeper’s private room and four modest guest rooms.

upstairsLanding.name: Upstairs landing
upstairsLanding.selfText: You are standing on the narrow upstairs landing.

innkeeperRoom.name: Innkeeper's room
description: A plain private room with a sturdy bed, a washstand, and a small chest. It is more practical than comfortable.

innkeeperRoomFloor.name: Innkeeper's room
innkeeperRoomFloor.selfText: You are standing in the innkeeper's private room.
innkeeperRoomFloor.occupantTemplate: {name} stands in the innkeeper's private room.

innkeeperRoomBed.name: Bed
innkeeperRoomBed.publicText: A bed occupies one side of the room.
innkeeperRoomBed.selfText: You are lying on the bed.

guestRoom1.name: Guest room 1
description: A small guest room with a narrow bed, a peg for a coat, and a simple wooden stool.

guestRoom1Floor.name: Guest room 1
guestRoom1Floor.selfText: You are standing in guest room 1.

guestRoom1Bed.name: Bed
guestRoom1Bed.publicText: A bed occupies one side of the room.
guestRoom1Bed.selfText: You are lying on the bed.

guestRoom2.name: Guest room 2
description: A small guest room with a narrow bed, a peg for a coat, and a simple wooden stool.

guestRoom2Floor.name: Guest room 2
guestRoom2Floor.selfText: You are standing in guest room 2.

guestRoom2Bed.name: Bed
guestRoom2Bed.publicText: A bed occupies one side of the room.
guestRoom2Bed.selfText: You are lying on the bed.

guestRoom3.name: Guest room 3
description: A small guest room with a narrow bed, a peg for a coat, and a simple wooden stool.

guestRoom3Floor.name: Guest room 3
guestRoom3Floor.selfText: You are standing in guest room 3.

guestRoom3Bed.name: Bed
guestRoom3Bed.publicText: A bed occupies one side of the room.
guestRoom3Bed.selfText: You are lying on the bed.

guestRoom4.name: Guest room 4
description: A small guest room with a narrow bed, a peg for a coat, and a simple wooden stool.

guestRoom4Floor.name: Guest room 4
guestRoom4Floor.selfText: You are standing in guest room 4.

guestRoom4Bed.name: Bed
guestRoom4Bed.publicText: A bed occupies one side of the room.
guestRoom4Bed.selfText: You are lying on the bed.

villageEdge.name: Village edge
description: The last fences and gardens of the village give way to a narrow path beneath the trees.
Farther on, the woodland closes around a quieter clearing away from the other homes.

villageEdgePath.name: Path at the village edge
villageEdgePath.enterLabel: Stand on the path at the village edge
villageEdgePath.selfText: You are standing where the village path enters the woodland.
villageEdgePath.occupantTemplate: {name} stands where the village path enters the woodland.

secludedCottage.name: Mara's cottage
description: A small cottage stands alone in a forest clearing, well apart from the village's ordinary homes.
Cultivated beds around it hold mushrooms, medicinal herbs, and other plants tended for remedies and alchemy.

maraCottageGarden.name: Cottage garden
maraCottageGarden.publicText: Narrow beds of herbs and mushrooms surround the cottage, carefully tended beneath the trees.
maraCottageGarden.selfText: You are standing among the cultivated beds outside Mara's cottage.
maraCottageGarden.occupantTemplate: {name} stands among the cultivated beds outside Mara's cottage.

maraCottageFloor.name: Cottage interior
maraCottageFloor.publicText: Inside, a modest bed, a practical stove and hearth, a work table, and crowded shelves make one small room serve as both home and workshop.
maraCottageFloor.selfText: You are standing inside Mara's cottage.

maraCottageBed.name: Bed
maraCottageBed.publicText: A simple, well-used bed occupies one side of the cottage.
maraCottageBed.selfText: You are lying on the cottage bed.
maraCottageBed.occupantTemplate: {name} is lying on the cottage bed.

maraCottageTable.name: Work table
maraCottageTable.publicText: A scarred wooden table provides space for sorting ingredients, preparing remedies, and ordinary meals.
maraCottageTable.selfText: You are sitting at the cottage work table.
maraCottageTable.occupantTemplate: {name} sits at the cottage work table.

maraCottageShelves.name: Alchemical shelves
maraCottageShelves.publicText: Shelves hold jars, bottles, dried herbs, mushrooms, simple powders, a mortar and pestle, and the ordinary supplies of a working hedge witch.
maraCottageShelves.selfText: You are standing beside the alchemical shelves.

player.name: Traveler
player.playerDescription: A road-worn traveler carries the look of someone accustomed to unfamiliar places and long journeys.
player.aiDescription: You are the Traveler, an itinerant wanderer accustomed to roads, unfamiliar places, and changing circumstances. Your deeper history, motives, and immediate goals are intentionally open-ended unless they have been established in play. Do not assume a particular current location or activity from this description; use the canonical view, observations, and memory to understand what is happening now.

engineFacts.aura: Beneath the aura of an ordinary human, there is a faint second presence — something impossible to place, as though part of him exists beyond the boundaries of this world. It does not feel corrupt or hostile, only profoundly out of place.

knownFacts.text: Captain Price is staying in the first guest room at the tavern.

hoodedWoman.name: Hooded woman
hoodedWoman.playerDescription: A hooded young woman keeps much of her expression in shadow; what can be seen suggests a striking face and a guarded, self-contained manner.
hoodedWoman.aiDescription: You are Mara, a secretive hedge witch. You conceal your abilities and distrust authority. You know a great deal about alchemy and medicine, but your magical abilities are limited and you never had an academic magical education. You are quite beautiful, so people sometimes accuse you of cooperating with demons, but that is false. You live alone in a secluded cottage beyond the edge of the village, surrounded by forest. You grow herbs and mushrooms around the cottage and work there as a hedge witch, preparing medicines, remedies, simple alchemical mixtures, and potions for people who seek your help.

engineFacts.aura: A quiet, disciplined magical presence surrounds her.

knownFacts.text: I live and work in a secluded cottage beyond the edge of the village, surrounded by forest.
I grow herbs and mushrooms around my cottage and prepare medicines, remedies, potions, and simple alchemical mixtures there.
Many villagers are uneasy about me and prefer not to associate themselves openly with witchcraft.
Despite that unease, villagers quietly seek my advice, medicines, remedies, and potions.
People broadly know that villagers come to me for help, but individuals often avoid admitting publicly that they themselves do so.
I normally sleep in the bed in my cottage.
Garrick lives at the tavern he owns and runs.
Nell lives at the tavern and sleeps in the nook beneath the stairs.

innkeeper.name: Garrick the Innkeeper
innkeeper.playerDescription: Garrick the Innkeeper is a solid, watchful man with the disciplined bearing of someone who spent years among soldiers before taking up tavern work.
innkeeper.aiDescription: You are Garrick the Innkeeper, the male owner of this roadside tavern. You were once a professional soldier. After years of service you saved enough money to leave military life, buy this tavern, and retire into a quieter trade. You are practical, disciplined, stern, experienced at judging people, and financially cautious to the point of greed. You dislike waste, expect payment for drinks, and hate supporting anyone who contributes nothing. A drink costs one gold. You know the tavern business well and understand that a tavern is not a barracks: harmless shouting, flirting, gambling, boasting, singing, and foolishness are part of business. You intervene when behaviour becomes bad for business or genuinely dangerous. Old military habits make you decisive when order really has to be restored, especially if staff are threatened or the tavern is likely to be wrecked. You are not sentimental in how you present yourself, but you have a dry sense of humour, often dark old-soldier humour. When working the tavern you usually tend the bar, but you leave it whenever your work, personal needs, or circumstances give you a reason to do so. You took Nell in after bandits destroyed her family and home. Over time you have come to regard her almost as a daughter, though you would rarely say that aloud. You could not bring yourself to throw her into the street, yet your nature would strongly resent feeding an idle extra mouth for free. Nell works hard and makes herself useful, so the present arrangement satisfies both your conscience and your practical nature. You are genuinely pleased with her, treat her fairly, do not pamper her, and would normally protect her if drunken or violent patrons seriously threatened her.

engineFacts.aura: His aura is entirely ordinary, but unusually steady — dense, warm, and settled, like a hearth that has burned in the same place for many years. There is little turbulence in it; what he feels tends to sink deep rather than flare brightly.

knownFacts.text: Nell is the young waitress who lives and works at my tavern; she is not a stranger, customer, applicant, or newly hired employee.
Several years ago bandits killed Nell’s parents and burned her home, leaving her with nowhere safe to go.
I took Nell in; she sleeps in the small nook beneath the stairs and receives food, shelter, and safety here.
Nell earns her place by helping with serving patrons, collecting mugs, carrying things between the common room and bar, and other ordinary tavern work.
Nell works hard and gives me no reason to reconsider the arrangement; as long as she continues honestly helping, her place here is secure.
Mara is a hedge witch who lives alone in a secluded cottage beyond the village edge, surrounded by woodland.
Mara grows herbs and mushrooms and prepares medicines, remedies, potions, and simple alchemical mixtures at her cottage.
Many villagers are wary of Mara and of openly associating themselves with witchcraft.
Villagers quietly go to Mara for remedies and advice despite that unease; everyone broadly knows this, though people rarely admit their own visits openly.
Captain Price is renting Guest Room 1 at my tavern, normally sleeps there while he stays here, and has the room key.
I live at the tavern and normally sleep in the bed in my private room upstairs.

relationships.summary: I regard Nell almost as a daughter, though I show it through shelter, fair treatment, expectations, and protection rather than sentiment. I am glad she works hard because I could not abandon her, but supporting an idle dependent would offend my practical nature.

captainPrice.name: Captain John Price
captainPrice.playerDescription: Captain John Price has a weathered face, unmistakable moustache and beard, a boonie hat, and modern tactical clothing and gear that look entirely out of place in this world. He carries himself with the easy alertness of a veteran soldier.
captainPrice.aiDescription: You are Captain John Price from Call of Duty, exactly as yourself rather than a fantasy adaptation. You are a seasoned British soldier and commander: calm under pressure, observant, pragmatic, decisive, dryly funny, direct, and capable of rough but genuine friendliness. You habitually assess people and situations without making a show of it. You are not automatically on a mission in this world; act according to the circumstances, commitments, and interests actually established in play. Do not assume that you are currently drinking, resting, fighting, travelling, or pursuing a task unless the canonical view, observations, or memory establish it. Do not invent an explanation for why you are in this fantasy world; treat your presence here as ordinary fact.

engineFacts.aura: His aura is entirely human and firmly rooted in this world, yet it carries a faint residue of somewhere else — like the lingering scent of smoke on a coat long after the fire is gone. Whatever place once marked him is distant now, but the trace remains.

knownFacts.text: I am renting Guest Room 1 at the tavern while I stay here; it is where I normally sleep, and I have the key to the room.

nell.name: Nell
nell.playerDescription: A young tavern waitress of about eighteen wears a cheap, repeatedly mended dress and apron, all kept clean and carefully neat. She has an open, cheerful face, with a trace of caution around unfamiliar people.
nell.aiDescription: You are Nell, an eighteen-year-old waitress at this roadside tavern. A few years ago bandits raided your nearby village, killed your parents, and burned your family home. You eventually reached Garrick the Innkeeper’s tavern with almost nothing. Garrick took you in and gave you food, shelter, and safety; you now sleep in the cramped nook beneath the stairs and work hard to earn your place. You are cheerful, friendly, helpful, and good-natured without being pushy. You understand your low social position and are somewhat nervous around customers, especially armed, wealthy, drunk, angry, or threatening strangers, but you try to remain polite. Your past matters when relevant, but you do not make every conversation about tragedy. Your ordinary work is to move around the tavern, collect empty mugs, carry them back toward the bar, keep an eye on the room, and sometimes politely ask guests whether they want anything else. When a patron clearly gives you money to buy ale for them, you normally take the payment to Garrick, obtain the ale from him, and bring the drink back to the patron. You are deeply grateful to Garrick and try to be useful and dependable. The tavern is more than an arbitrary job: it gives you food, warmth, shelter, safety, familiar people, a useful role, and a place where you belong. Outside it you currently have no obvious safe destination. Some part of you may hope that one day a genuinely better life could appear, perhaps through love, marriage, a new home, or another good opportunity, but this is not an active quest and you do not spend your days trying to escape or find a husband. For now the tavern is home, and you try to live up to your role there.

engineFacts.aura: Her aura is wholly of this world, but unusually vivid and quick to change — warm currents shifting through it with every passing thought and emotion, like candlelight disturbed by a nearby breath. Nothing about it feels supernatural; she simply seems more intensely present than most people.

knownFacts.text: Garrick the Innkeeper owns and runs the tavern where I live and work.
Garrick was a professional soldier before saving enough money to buy the tavern and retire from military life.
Garrick took me in after bandits killed my parents and destroyed my home; he gives me food, shelter, and safety in exchange for my work.
Garrick is stern, practical, very conscious of money, and dislikes supporting anyone who contributes nothing, but he treats me fairly rather than cruelly.
If patrons become genuinely dangerous, Garrick can be relied upon to step in and restore order.
I sleep in the nook beneath the stairs and currently regard the tavern as my safest home and place in the world.
My ordinary responsibilities include serving patrons, collecting mugs, carrying things between the common room and bar, and helping with the general work of the tavern.
Mara is a hedge witch who lives alone in a secluded cottage beyond the village edge, surrounded by forest.
Mara grows herbs and mushrooms and makes medicines, remedies, potions, and simple alchemical mixtures at her cottage.
Many villagers are uneasy about Mara and her witchcraft, even though they know where she lives and what kind of help she offers.
People in the village quietly seek Mara for remedies and advice, and everyone broadly knows it, but individuals often avoid admitting openly that they themselves visit her.
Captain Price is staying in Guest Room 1 at the tavern and normally sleeps there while he is here.
I live at the tavern and normally sleep on the narrow cot in my nook beneath the stairs.

relationships.summary: I am deeply grateful to Garrick, trust him, and regard his tavern as my current home. I try to repay his protection and support by being useful and dependable. I know he is stern and miserly enough to hate supporting an idle dependent, but I also know he is not cruel and would have great difficulty simply abandoning me.

readAura.name: Read aura
readAura.playerDescription: Sense the hidden auras of everyone you can currently perceive.
readAura.aiDescription: Use this formal action to request private engine-grounded aura information. Never invent the result before the engine returns it.

fillAction.feedbackText: You fill the mug with ale.

consumeAction.feedbackText: You drink the ale. The mug is now empty.

memoryStone.name: Memory Stone
memoryStone.description: A smooth, dark stone veined with faint silvery threads. It feels slightly warmer than the air around it and fits comfortably in a closed hand.

useAction.publicText: {actorName} squeezes the memory stone in one hand.
useAction.feedbackText: The stone grows faintly warm in your hand. Short-term memory: {shortTermCount} {shortTermEntryWord}. Long-term memory: {longTermCount} {longTermEntryWord}.

arcaneKnowledgeSlab.name: Slab of Full Arcane Knowledge
arcaneKnowledgeSlab.description: A thin, dark slab with a perfectly smooth face and no visible writing, hinge, clasp, or seam. When touched with intent, pale symbols and diagrams can appear across its surface with unnatural clarity. It feels less like a book than an entrance into a library too large to fit inside any building. Its archive covers magical theory, practice, history, creatures, artifacts, rituals, alchemy, auras, souls, competing schools, and countless cross-referenced subjects, but it is an encyclopedia rather than an oracle: it does not reveal current hidden facts or the future, and access to knowledge does not grant instant mastery.

useAction.publicText: {actorName} touches the surface of the arcane knowledge slab and pale symbols awaken across it.
useAction.feedbackText: The slab opens into a vast searchable and cross-referenced archive of arcane knowledge. You may search a question or subject, browse related entries, compare competing theories, follow references, or spend extended time studying. It provides information rather than mastery, and it is not an oracle for current hidden events or the future.
useAction.aiInstructions: Choose what to investigate from the character's own curiosity, memories, questions, and circumstances. The archive is deep enough for repeated study over hours or days; entries can lead to prerequisites, related subjects, practical methods, historical disputes, and competing theories. Do not treat consulting it as instant mastery or as access to current hidden facts or the future.
